profile.headline: Sr Engineer | Strategic Planning | Fullstack Development
profile.summary: Senior Engineering Leader with over 9 years of experience driving the design, development, and deployment of innovative fullstack applications and backend infrastructure. Hands-on Leader and Trusted Advisor focused on building and empowering diverse engineering teams while aligning business requirements with technology roadmaps to deliver new cutting-edge solutions at scale.

positions.title: Senior II Software Engineer
positions.description:
Spearheaded the technical direction for Smartsheet’s strategic AI foundations, collaborating with the KnowledgeGraph and Search teams to evaluate technical possibilities for the First-Time User Experience (FTUE) project, while proactively identifying and resolving critical authorization gaps.

Led the high-complexity project, managing a multi-codebase initiative across four services to successfully deliver a 10% increase in onboarding completion.

Navigated high ambiguity as the technical lead for initiative, consulting across service boundaries to define the technical roadmap for onboarding across RM and Scenario Planning.

Acted as a trusted mentor to junior engineers and a key second-opinion for senior leadership, successfully transitioning from 'owning the plan' to 'teaching the team to own the plan' while offloading execution to a team of five engineers.

Drove operational excellence for the Scenario Planning initiative, collaborating cross-functionally to manage interdepartmental alignment and performance optimizations, ensuring high-quality, bug-free releases for key delivery milestones.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Rearchitecting a customer-facing Python API interfacing with Rust and Timely Dataflow to increase the accessibility of terminology and functions, streamline the user experience, and increase overall utilization.
- Architected Kafka Consumer to enable autoscaling for message processing & recovery with multiple workers via partitioning.
- Established new work processes and customer priorities such as standups, roadmaps, prioritization meetings, product brainstorming sessions, and improved testing in collaboration with senior stakeholders.

positions.title: SDE III/Engineering Lead/Interim Manager
positions.description:
- Designed, architected, and documented patterns for feature work on a high-scale application while leading a team of 8 software engineers, facilitating sprint planning, 1-1s, retrospectives, and standups, and driving interdepartmental alignment.
- Defined a new 6-month roadmap with Senior Leadership by identifying priorities for migrating to cloud-based architecture, introducing tenancy, and partnering with a new provider to achieve SOC2-compliant tenant authentication/authorization.
- Partnered with the UX team to define and execute engineering epics and milestones extracted from product epics.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer I/II
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented Role-Based Access Control and Resource-Based Authorization for Chef Automate Identity and Access Management to enable the authorization of users across data types and increase the range of available customers.
- Designed the process for managing authorization across microservices to optimize speed, reliability, and security.
- Worked within the deployment team to deploy and maintain greenfield Golang APIs covering all microservices and databases of Chef Automate’s continuous deployment system, replacing a monolithic app in Ruby.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, developed, and enhanced the customer-facing Estately iOS and Web applications and internal tools for recording and tracking customer service calls and documenting potential client listings.
- Built an algorithm to accurately predict home values and competitive offers based on location, market trends, and features.
- Established and streamlined the hiring process, criteria, and rubric by developing interview questions and evaluation criteria for interviewees and defining processes to reduce bias and maximize diversity.

educations.fieldOfStudy: English with a Minors in Spanish and Film
